sn_aia_tool.description: Applies policy-based rules to flag out-of-date or soon-out-of-date plugins by comparing installed versions against available versions. Returns a list of plugins requiring upgrade attention.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"installed_data","description":"JSON string of installed plugin data with name, version, and sys_id","mandatory":true},{"name":"available_data","description":"JSON string of available update data with target versions","mandatory":true}]
sn_aia_tool.name: Identify Outdated Plugins
